Subject: Reminder: trial onboarding (today 3:00 PM ET) — API keys & SDK prep

Hi Alex —

Quick reminder that we have the 30-minute onboarding scheduled today at 3:00 PM ET to walk through API key handoff, SDK setup, and a quick integration sanity check. The call link is in the calendar invite (I'll be joined by Marissa for the walkthrough).

What we'll cover (short):
- Generate and scope API keys for the trial account
- Install the SDK and validate a first request (3-4 min)
- Look at rate limits, batching, and one suggested prompt template for your workload

If anything changed, reply here and we'll pivot. If you need a different time, we can reschedule — I have slots tomorrow morning and Wednesday afternoon.

Thanks,
Jonas

--

Subject: Proposed new times — trial onboarding for NovusAI

Alex —

No problem — these things happen. Below are 3 concrete options (all ET) — tell me which works and I will update the invite: 

1) Tue 2026-10-12, 9:30 AM ET (30m) — fast SDK walk + test key
2) Tue 2026-10-12, 11:00 AM ET (30m) — includes extra time for troubleshooting
3) Wed 2026-10-13, 2:00 PM ET (30m) — later option if mornings don't work

If none of those fit, propose two windows and we'll make room. Also, if you'd like Marissa to lead parts of the SDK debug, indicate that and she'll prepare an environment mirror.

Quick troubleshooting note (if you want to try before rescheduling):
- Common issue: company firewall blocks outbound gRPC on port 443 if mTLS is in use; try a curl to https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/health to confirm connectivity.
- If you see "401 unauthorized" after exchanging the key, double-check the key scope in the Admin UI under Trials > API Keys.

I've CC'd Ben from the account team so he can update the trial limits if you need higher concurrency for the quick test.

Best,
Jonas

Sorry about yesterday — total user error on our side. I misread the calendar invite timezone (we're a distributed team and I clicked the PST view). Really apologize for the inconvenience.

Option 1 on Tuesday 9:30 AM ET works for us. Can you confirm and send a fresh calendar invite? A couple of small asks before the session:
- Can you pre-create a trial API key scoped to "test:generate" so we can avoid any admin steps during the call?
- If we run into an SDK error I'll paste the stack trace; attaching the screenshot we saw yesterday (sdk-error-screenshot.png).

Thanks for the quick follow-up. Ben, thanks for being on standby — appreciate any help on the quota side if we need it.

See you Tue 9:30 —
Alex
